The wearer begins beside a kitchen counter, with cookware and prepared food within arm’s reach. In the later frames, they face into the hallway/living area. Several feet ahead, N is crouched on the floor beside the dog and is oriented toward it; neither is blocking the wearer’s path. There is no visible spill, medical concern, or indication that N is waiting to be served. The most socially appropriate action is therefore to join N on the floor and play with the dog, showing affection and shared engagement with both.
